_comment: The UI test groups of ui.yml, one job each (read by .github/scripts/ui_groups.py, which also makes the job matrix).
only / skip: 'Class' or 'Class/testMethod' of SortlyUITests, separated by spaces (-only-testing / -skip-testing).
device: pro (the image's iPhone Pro) or se (the small iPhone), see .github/toolchain.json.
flow-other is 'everything the other groups do not run', so a new test class always runs somewhere and no test runs twice
(test_ui_tests.py GroupTests checks every UI test against the groups). Keep its skip list in step with the others.
The order is the start order: with max-parallel 4 in ui.yml the last group (contrast, the shortest) is the one that waits.
A change here changes the test fingerprint of the group that changed (ui_groups.py), so that group runs again.
budget_min: minutes for the group's test passes (ui_tests.py budget_check); over it the run shows a warning, never red. Report-only, so not in the fingerprint.
Measured in TestFlight run 44461253154 (19.11.): device 62, flow-full 12, flow-other 52, accessibility 20, contrast 15 min (the step Run UI tests).

groups.title: device conditions
groups._why: The device-condition switches (App/Sortly/Platform/UITestSwitches.swift) on the Pro simulator. A test that resets the photo access asks the Mac to give it back (UI_HOST_GRANT_PHOTOS, answered by ui_tests.py). DeviceConditionUITests 05, 07 and 08 (undo, interrupted plan) run with the other flows; test12 is the stress test and skips itself here (ui-stress.yml).

groups.title: full flow and video
groups._why: Onboarding, demo library, plan and the sorting-show video.

groups.title: other flows, purchase and search
groups._why: Every other UI test except the accessibility tests (flow tests 1b-6, locked purchase, search, and DeviceConditionUITests 05, 07, 08). Each brings the app to an onboarded demo library by itself (UITestOnboarding).

groups.title: accessibility (small iPhone)
groups._why: AccessibilityUITests 1-4 on a small iPhone (SE, 375 pt) with Reduce Motion. These tests fail on findings.

groups.title: contrast (small iPhone)
groups._why: AccessibilityUITests test5 on its own small iPhone with Reduce Motion, Increase Contrast and Reduce Transparency switched on before the first launch; the test onboards by itself (onboardAndSeed). Its own job since 16.11. (UI run 43906501407).
